data.description: Beach Access | Sunset View | Luxury Living
data.display_address: Sunrise Bay Tower 1, Emaar Beachfront, Dubai Harbour, Dubai
data.long_description:
Provident is proud to present to you this luxurious beach apartment at Emaar Beachfront.

The living/dining area is spacious, the floor to ceiling windows let in tons of natural creating a light and airy living experience.

Enjoy your morning coffee from your balcony with partial sea views and stunning views of the Marina skyline. This apartment is ideal for people who prefer lower floors.

On of the key benefits of living at Emaar Beachfront is having direct beach access, it is always Beach O`clock at Sunrise bay. You can also enjoy the pool & gym at your convenience .

The apartment:

-Patial Sea View & Marina Skyline view
-2 bedroom
-1,140 sq.ft (106 sq.m)
-2 bath
-Laundry room
-1 basement parking included

Amenities:

-Private beach access for residents
-Pool & Gym
-24/7 reception & security
-The Six Café (ground floor)
-Roasters Specialty coffee café (next building)
-More Café`s & restaurants alongside the private beach

Location:

- 5 min to Dubai Marina
- 10 min to Palm Jumeirah
- 12 min to Mall of the Emirates
- 20 min to Downtown
- 25 min to DXB airport

It is always Beach O’clock and Sunrise Bay. Discover Dubai your way at Emaar Beachfront.
